(
	FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `Students`(`student_id`),
	`date_of_enrolment` DATETIME NOT NULL, -- Example Values: `('2017-10-09 07:09:02',)`, `('2017-11-13 12:49:33',)`, `('2017-10-17 13:50:40',)`   
	`student_id` INTEGER NOT NULL, -- Example Values: `11`, `15`, `10`, `13`, `14`   
	`registration_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	`date_of_completion` DATETIME NOT NULL, -- Example Values: `('2018-02-26 07:48:52',)`, `('2018-03-04 01:24:56',)`, `('2018-03-22 02:53:01',)`   
);

CREATE TABLE Students
(
	`family_name` VARCHAR(40), -- Example Values: `Ward`, `Jaskolski`, `Legros`, `Langosh`, `Schumm`   
	`personal_name` VARCHAR(40), -- Example Values: `Wilson`, `Karson`, `Mariela`, `Krystel`, `Autumn`   
	`student_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
);
